title: Tracing the Jerusalem Code
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
summary: With the aim to write the history of Christianity in Scandinavia with Jerusalem as a lens, this book investigates the image – or rather the imagination – of Jerusalem in the religious, political, and artistic cultures of Scandinavia through most of the second millennium. Volume III analyses the impact of Jerusalem on Scandinavian Christianity from the middle of the 18. century in a broad context.
